note: Literature directly demonstrates that dark-adapted full-field ERG abnormalities (electronegative or absent) occur in CLN3 disease but not in early-onset STGD1 at presentation.

evidence.text: In a cohort of 38 children presenting with rapid vision loss (18 with CLN3 disease and 20 with early-onset STGD1), dark-adapted full-field ERG responses in CLN3 disease were either absent or electronegative, whereas in early-onset STGD1 they were generally unaffected and none had an electronegative ERG.

source.title: Recognizing differentiating clinical signs of CLN3 disease (Batten disease) at presentation
source.quote: In CLN3 disease, dark-adapted (DA) full-field electroretinogram (ERG) responses were either absent or electronegative. In early-onset STGD1, DA ERG responses were generally unaffected. None of the STGD1 patients had an electronegative ERG.

evidence.text: All five confirmed CLN3 patients presenting with visual decline and maculopathy demonstrated electronegative ERGs on full-field electroretinography.

source.title: Early recognition of CLN3 disease facilitated by visual electrophysiology and multimodal imaging
source.quote: Electronegative ERGs were identified in all patients.
